verdict.rationale: The evidence shows more control and economics are available within the same Connect platform: you can move from embedded onboarding to API-driven custom onboarding, and platform pricing tools let you set your own processing pricing. Nothing in the pack shows a path to registered payment facilitator status, so only the 'more control and economics' part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any documented graduation to registered payfac (e.g. sponsor-bank registration or a liability shift to the platform), evidence that migration needs no replatforming, a published economics or revenue-share uplift tied to taking on liability, and independent corroboration.
